name: independent_calendar_protection_window

windowFields.windowId: UUID unique per explicitly scheduled window
windowFields.endsAt: absolute UTC ISO-8601 instant, fixed after scheduling
windowFields.targetRefs: array of opaque platform-specific selected target IDs
windowFields.reliefRemainingSeconds: persisted nonnegative integer no greater than budget
windowFields.reliefUntil: absolute UTC ISO-8601 instant or null
windowFields.state: inactive | active | limited-relief | rest | exit-pending | exit | expired
windowFields.exitCoolingOffSeconds: positive integer configured before activation; initial value is a hypothesis, not a proven optimum
windowFields.exitAvailableAt: absolute UTC ISO-8601 instant or null, persisted when exit is requested
windowFields.stateBeforeExitPending: active | limited-relief | rest | null; underlying restrictions and relief deadline continue while pending

transitions.inactive: at startsAt activate selected restrictions if available; end or explicit exit wins
transitions.active: explicit limited relief, rest, or request full exit; full exit first enters exit-pending; at endsAt expire
transitions.limited-relief: reserve grant before opening; at reliefUntil restore available restrictions and offer explicit return; explicit early return restores restrictions; full exit first enters exit-pending; at endsAt expire
transitions.rest: selected feed restrictions remain active; explicit return to active or request full exit (exit-pending); at endsAt expire
transitions.exit: terminal for this window; release restrictions and preserve task and history
transitions.expired: terminal for this window; release restrictions and preserve task and history
transitions.exit-pending: persist exitAvailableAt at request; preserve underlying restrictions, relief deadline and budget; cancel returns to the current underlying state; after exitAvailableAt explicit confirmation enters exit; endsAt expires regardless of pending; emergency/system exemptions remain available

grantRule: grant = min(reliefMaxGrantSeconds, reliefRemainingSeconds, whole_seconds_until_endsAt); grant must be positive; atomically persist remaining minus entire grant and reliefUntil before release; early return does not refund; disclose before grant
persistence: persist window and budget independently of timer and task; restart, stop, new task and rest do not replenish budget or extend endsAt; reconstruct reliefUntil and expire on wake; storage failure must not claim enforcement or issue unrecorded grant; the daily consumed relief budget is not reset by schedule edits, schedule replacement, explicit re-enrollment or a new window on the same local date
clockAndEnforcement: reconcile absolute instants on wake or clock change, report uncertainty or unavailable permissions and actual enforcement honestly; never infer concentration or claim cross-device synchronization
eventNote: local lifecycle names only; export through an explicitly versioned compatible event contract, do not silently extend event-v1.schema.json
legacy: session-policy-v1 25 to 30 minute protection extension is an independent historical hypothesis; it does not extend or reset this absolute-end window

recurringSchedule.weekdays: nonempty set of ISO weekday numbers 1=Monday to 7=Sunday
recurringSchedule.endLocalTime: HH:mm:ss later on the same local date
recurringSchedule.instance: the instance is retained across restart and repeated schedule evaluation; consumed relief is stored in a daily ledger by localDate independently of scheduleId; separate explicit re-enrollment after a terminal exit may create a new instance, but cannot restore spent budget
recurringSchedule.changeRule: changes or disablement affect future rules, not an active instance; repeated evaluation cannot create a fresh budget; exit-pending deadline cannot be shortened by schedule edits or new tasks; explicit re-enrollment after exit does not reset spent daily budget
recurringSchedule.scope: local device only; no cross-device synchronization claim

exitRule: requesting full exit persists pending state and exitAvailableAt before displaying the waiting state; require a separate confirmation at or after that instant; relaunch, timer stop, task change, recurring schedule edits and repeated requests cannot shorten the deadline or release restrictions; expiration at endsAt always wins; if relief expires while pending, restore available restrictions; missing permissions/enforcement and OS/admin bypasses must be reported honestly; user may cancel pending; no punishment or unbounded wait
